summary: Rewrote the Unity extension's local design components (Button, SelectField, ConfirmDialog) to use bits-ui primitives with consistent styling, and updated the web extension build script to inline the shared design CSS into a standalone <style> tag injected at runtime. Tests passed (139/139) and tsc clean; Prettier formatted the three Svelte components after explicit plugin invocation.
decisions: Button, SelectField, and ConfirmDialog in packages/unity/src/web/design/ are now Svelte wrappers over bits-ui (Button.Root, Select.Root/Trigger/Content/Viewport/Item, Dialog.Root/Portal/Content) instead of bare HTML elements, exposing variant/size/onOpenChange-style callbacks.

scripts/build-web-extension.ts prepends a generated runtime stylesheet to web.js that creates and appends a <style> element to document.head so the shared @gizmo/design CSS loads when the extension is dynamically imported.
errors: Prettier could not infer a parser for the .svelte files until --plugin=prettier-plugin-svelte was passed explicitly; running with the plugin reported style issues that --write then fixed.
svelte-autofixer flagged a possible malpractice for invoking onCancel inside an $effect in ConfirmDialog.svelte; left as a suggestion rather than a blocking issue.
Earlier reads of apps/app/src/lib/design/Button.svelte, apps/app/src/lib/components/ConfirmDialog.svelte and Button.svelte failed with ENOENT because those paths do not exist in the active project.
